description: Open or add to a position. Without confirm, returns the quote, the local policy check and a quote_id, and signs nothing. With confirm: true and that quote_id, the guardian rebuilds the order, checks the policy again and signs it with the agent key.

confirm.description: The user's agreement to this order. Without it nothing is signed.

limit_px.description: The limit price, with type limit

margin.description: cross or isolated: the margin the leverage is set in (default: the position's, or the market's; a market that takes isolated only refuses cross). The leverage is set for the whole market

max_slippage_bps.description: The worst price accepted, in basis points from the mid (default 300)

quote_id.description: The quote_id of the quote this confirms, as the same call without confirm returned it.

reduce_only.description: Only reduce the position held, the side the other way: no leverage set, no margin taken, always allowed by the policy as a close

size.description: The size in the base asset, e.g. 0.01

symbol.description: The market, e.g. BTC, ETH, xyz:GOLD

tif.description: With type limit: gtc (default) rests until cancelled, ioc fills what it can at once and cancels the rest, alo is posted to the book only and refused if it would fill at once

trigger_px.description: The entry trigger, with type trigger: a long above the price, a short below; no tp or sl with it

type.description: market (default), limit, or trigger (a market order once the price reaches trigger_px)

name: perps_open
title: Open a position
